verdict.rationale: The only first-party integration in the evidence is Marketing Hub's documented bi-directional Salesforce sync, which also pushes lead scores to Salesforce. That shows the product maintains native integrations, but none of the systems the story names are evidenced. The Marketing Emails API and MCP server are developer building blocks, not maintained integrations, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: Stripe or Shopify integration, Segment/CDP integration, product-database connector, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect the platform to my existing stack — Stripe or Shopify, a CDP like Segment, my product database — with maintained first-party integrations

citations.quote: Marketing Hub has a powerful bi-directional sync with Salesforce, which means that any changes made in one system are automatically synced to the other.
You can also send lead scores from HubSpot to Salesforce
